items.prose: Fermat says $3^6 \equiv 1 \pmod 7$. So exponents of 3 can be reduced modulo 6.
items.question: What is $3^{10^{18}} \bmod 7$?

feedback.generic: Not quite right. Reduce the exponent modulo $p - 1 = 6$ first.

byKey.mod7: You reduced the exponent modulo 7. Fermat's cycle has length $p - 1 = 6$.
byKey.e0: You treated $10^{18}$ as a multiple of 6. $10 \equiv 4 \pmod 6$, and every power of 4 is $\equiv 4$.

explain.text: $3^{10^{18}} = (3^6)^k \cdot 3^4 \equiv 3^4 \equiv 4$. Reducing an exponent modulo $p - 1$ works only for a prime $p$ that does not divide the base.

items.prose: A desk splits 10 identical lots between 4 traders; a trader may get none.
items.question: How many splits are there?

items.prose: A program builds factorial tables modulo 7 and asks for $\binom{8}{1}$.
items.question: What goes wrong?

options.text: It needs $(7!)^{-1}$, and $7! \equiv 0 \pmod 7$ has no inverse

options.why: The formula multiplies by $((8-1)!)^{-1}$, which does not exist modulo 7.
Every entry is reduced modulo 7, so nothing grows.

feedback.generic: Not quite right. Look at $(n - k)!$ modulo 7.

explain.text: From $7!$ on every factorial is $\equiv 0 \pmod 7$, so its inverse does not exist and `pow` returns 0. With a prime above $n$, such as $10^9 + 7$, this never happens.

items.prose: Six tokens in three boxes: 4, 1 and 1. A move takes two tokens from one box and puts one in each other box. $(A - B) \bmod 3$ and $(B - C) \bmod 3$ are both 0, as they are with all six in one box.
items.question: Can all six end in one box?

options.text: No: a position with all six in one box has no position before it

options.why: Agreement only fails to rule it out. Undoing a move into $(6, 0, 0)$ needs $-1$ tokens in a box.

options.text: Only a computer search can tell
options.why: One step back settles it: the target has no parent.

feedback.generic: Not quite right. What position could come just before $(6, 0, 0)$?

explain.text: Undoing a move adds 2 to one box and takes 1 from each other. From $(6, 0, 0)$ that leaves a negative box, so only a start can be all in one box. A search finds just 7 reachable positions, none of them the target.
